unit.why: A single anecdote: a tsaddik honours R. Menahem Mendel despite his costly dress and upright bearing, and explains to his puzzled hasidim with a parable.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי שהרה"ק הנ"ל היה נוהג שהיה
stories.summary_en: R. Menahem Mendel wore very costly clothes and walked upright. A tsaddik who honoured him explained to his hasidim, who thought the guest proud, with a parable: as a man hides his money under a dunghill, R. Menahem Mendel hides his great treasure of awe of Heaven under a garment of pride.

quotes: הטמין אותו תחת הלבוש של גאות
tags.why: The tsaddik's costly dress is the subject of the story.

quotes: הלא הוא בעל גאה מאוד שהולך בקומה זקופה
tags.why: The hasidim suspect him of arrogance.

quotes: יש לו אוצר גדול של יראת שמי
tags.why: His hidden treasure is awe of Heaven.
Outward pride conceals inner piety, implicitly humility.

quotes: אני אומר לכם משל לאחד שהיה לו מעות הרבה
tags.why: The tsaddik answers with a mashal.
The point is to show R. Menahem Mendel's hidden piety.

quotes: והיה פ״א אצל צדיק אחד והצדיק כבד אותו מאוד
tags.why: A visit and honour between tsaddikim, questioned by hasidim.
The hasidim learn that his apparent pride hid inner piety.

quotes: וכשהלך הרה״ק ר׳ מ״מ זצ״ל מהצדיק הנ״ל
tags.why: The tsaddik's visit to another tsaddik frames the story.

missing_concepts: concealment of piety behind an outward show (inverse of hypocrisy)
outward bearing and posture of a tsaddik
